description: Ask the Recordist app to write a meeting's AI notes again. They replace the current notes and open action items (Recordist keeps the earlier ones under Earlier notes; the person's own notes stay). `kind` is summary, action_items, decisions, questions, followup_email or custom; `template_id` selects a template. Requires the app to be running.
name: regenerate_notes
title: Regenerate notes
